description: Write Book 5 of 9: '오멜라스: 시편 (Omelas: Psalms)' in Korean. A more lyrical, interior book: a collection of connected chapters that are the songs, prayers, laments, and inner monologues of characters across the factions (an Evangelist's hymn to baptism, an Untransformed mother's lament, a Scientist's cold prayer, a migrated consciousness inside World 3.0 speaking). Provides emotional depth and a breather between action books while advancing character interiority. Depends on FEAT-001; follows Books 1-4.
steps: Write ~5-6 Korean chapters, each framed as a psalm/prayer/lament/hymn from a distinct character or faction viewpoint, using more poetic and reflective Korean prose while staying narrative.
Include at least one 'psalm' voiced from inside World 3.0 (a digital consciousness) to deepen the metaphysics.
Keep continuity of characters and events from Books 1-4 per canon/story-bible-ko.md.
acceptance_criteria: books/05-psalms/ contains 00-index.md and >=5 Korean chapter files in a lyrical/psalm form.
At least one chapter is voiced from within World 3.0; consistent with canon.
verification: Run: ls books/05-psalms/ and confirm files exist.
Run: cat books/05-psalms/chapter-*.md | wc -m and confirm ~11,000-14,000 characters.
Spot-read a chapter for Korean lyrical prose and continuity.
findings: Book 5 (오멜라스: 시편 / Psalms) complete. Created books/05-psalms/ with 00-index.md + 6 Korean chapter files, each a distinct psalm/prayer/lament/hymn voice. Character counts (wc -m): ch01=2156 (이가온's hymn-to-baptism turning to doubt), ch02=1913 (Untransformed mother's lament), ch03=2125 (서명주's cold prayer to a god she doesn't believe in), ch04=2051 (psalm from INSIDE World 3.0, a migrated digital consciousness), ch05=1893 (노아's night prayer / robot-god's lament), ch06=2028 (미르 the dog's silent 'song' + 한서린's closing psalm). Chapter total = 12,166 Korean chars (target ~12,150, range 11,000-14,000). No em dashes (verified via grep). Continuity from Book 4 honored: aftermath of the tribunal, the 'baptism someday' verdict, 이가온's collapsed faith, 노아's promise to open the robot-to-human path with 정도현, 서명주's tribunal testimony (삼백열둘 표본). New minor characters/terms introduced: 서말순 (Seo Malsun, an Untransformed mother, minor) and her son 준서 (Junseo, baptized then migrated; voices the World 3.0 psalm in ch04 and appears at the mother's table in ch02). No new canonical terms; all glossary terms used as fixed. Book closes by handing the core questions (열반 vs 소멸, robot-to-human) forward to Book 6 (잠언). No build/test system (prose repo); verification is file-existence + wc -m + em-dash grep, all passing.
